rules.title: Row Level Security everywhere
rules.text: Enable Row Level Security on every table in an exposed schema and write explicit policies.

rules.title: Keep the service role key private
rules.text: Never ship the secret key (the legacy service_role key) to a browser or mobile app; it bypasses Row Level Security, so use it only on trusted servers.

rules.title: Policies on auth.uid()
rules.text: Base policies on auth.uid() and verify ownership in the policy, not only in the client.

rules.title: Schema through migrations
rules.text: Change the schema through versioned migrations from the Supabase CLI, not in the dashboard.

rules.title: Generated types
rules.text: Generate TypeScript types from the database schema and use them in the client.
